### Description
Please provide a description of the bug. To make tracing an issue easier, provide the **command** you used, the **error message**, a **log file** (add the `--log-level error` flag to generate one) and a description of the **data** you used (DNA/RNA, R9/R10, etc). If possible also provide (a subset of) the POD5 and BAM data.

### Environment:
- Fishnet version: [e.g., v0.4.1, v0.4.0]
- OS: [e.g., Ubuntu24, Linux Mint 22.3, Windows]
